title.en: Hikikomori Reijou wa Hanashi no Wakaru Seijuuban
Magaimo no Reijou Kara Aisare Kusushi ni Narimashita
Mofumofu Majuu to Heion ni Kurashitai no de Kowamote Koushaku no Kyuukon wa Okotowari desu
Uranaishi ni wa Hana Kishi no Koigokoro ga Mieteimasu
Dare ni mo Aisarenai no de Yuka wo Migaite Itara Soko ga Seiiki-ka shita Reijou no Hanashi
Ane no Koto ga Sukina Hittou Majutsushi-sama ni Migawari de Totsuidara, Naze ka Watashi ga Dekiai saremashita!? ~Munou Reijou wa Kuni Ichiban no Kekkai Majutsushi ni Kaika suru~
Danna-sama ga Chicchai Mofumofu ni narimashita ~Watashi wo Akujo da to Gokai shiteita no ni, Subete Gibo no Uso da to Kizuita you desu~
Umagoya Kurashi no Goreijou wa Angai Ryoushu ni Muiteiru?
Akujo no Watashi wo Shokei shita Kishi Danchou ni, Naze ka Dekiaisaretemasu
Meryoku no nai Otaku Reijou wa, Jiki Koushaku-sama no Ichizu na Dekiai ni Honrousareru
Akugyaku Seijo desu ga, Aisuru Danna-sama no Oyaku ni Tachitai desu. (To wa Ie, Kirawarete Iru no desu ga)
Shukujo no Kagami Yamemashita. Toki wo Gyakkou shita Koushaku Reijou wa, Wagamama na Imouto ni Furimawasarenai you Seikaku Waruku Ikinobimasu!
Kurokishi-sama kara Zenryoku de Dekiaisareteimasu ga, Sugomori Seijo wa Kyou mo Hikikomoritai!
Kodomo Atsukai Shinaide Kudasai! - Youjoka Shichatta Kanpeki Shukujo wa, Kishi Danchou ni Amayakasareru
